extraction.summary: Two scalar-field EDE realizations raise pre-recombination expansion, reduce the sound horizon, and allow higher CMB-inferred H0 while preserving angular CMB scales. Their 2019 joint fit reports comparable BAO/SN fits, improved total fit, and testable CMB/LSS signatures.

ideas.title: Transient EDE reduces the sound horizon
ideas.description: Frozen EDE later dilutes faster than radiation, raising early expansion and reducing rs; authors find about 5% energy fraction near z≈5000.

ideas.title: Oscillating and slowly rolling scalar realizations
ideas.description: An oscillating cosine-power potential yields post-onset dilution from matter-like (n=1) to faster-than-radiation (n≥3). A second, slowly rolling field has an early linear potential; its detailed analysis was deferred.

ideas.title: CMB scale compensation selects onset and model shape
ideas.description: EDE lowers rs while parameter shifts preserve CMB angular scales and peak heights. Authors favor onset near equality and models minimizing rs/rD change; n=3 has strongest reported EDE evidence.

ideas.title: Perturbations are required for physical CMB predictions
ideas.description: The effective-fluid calculation evolves EDE density and heat-flux perturbations. Authors say omitting them violates energy conservation and produces unphysical CMB features.

ideas.title: CMB residuals and structure growth provide tests
ideas.description: The fit predicts oscillatory TT/EE residuals and matter-clustering signatures. Its higher S8 worsens the cited KiDS discrepancy.

data_dependencies: Planck high-ℓ and low-ℓ TT, TE, EE plus lensing likelihood (Planck 2015 likelihood); neutrino model: two massless species and one massive species with Mν=0.06 eV.
SH0ES H0=73.52±1.62 km/s/Mpc; BAO: 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (including fσ8); Pantheon 1048 SNe Ia over 0.01<z<2.3.
Inference uses modified CLASS and MontePython MCMC, stated flat priors and nuisance parameters; evidence uses MultiNest and lite high-ℓ likelihood.
caveats: All fit claims are conditional on 2019 data and methods; they do not establish resolution today.
The slow-roll analysis was deferred; perturbation treatment is material to the result.
The fitted S8 shift worsens the cited KiDS discrepancy.

usefulness.reason: Foundational, explicit transient-EDE mechanism with background equations, perturbation requirements, fit outputs, and discriminating CMB/LSS signatures; merits current-data and overlap review before any design use.

citation_leads.reason: Cited effective-fluid treatment and cosmological implications of ultra-light axion-like fields; relevant for checking the perturbation prescription.
Cited earlier early-dark-energy/string-axiverse proposal that motivates the transient component.
Reference [41], Karwal et al. (2019), is cited for detailed background and perturbation dynamics of the slowly rolling realization; the bibliography gives no arXiv identifier.
